# Support

Thanks for trying KOLONİ. It is an early project, looked after on a best-effort basis.

Where to get help:

- **Issues**: bug reports and clear feature requests, at
  [github.com/flyingriverhorse/Koloni/issues](https://github.com/flyingriverhorse/Koloni/issues).
- **Discussions**: questions, ideas and help with your setup, at
  [github.com/flyingriverhorse/Koloni/discussions](https://github.com/flyingriverhorse/Koloni/discussions).
- **Security**: never in a public issue; report it privately as [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) says.

Before opening an issue:

- Search the existing issues and discussions, and the guide's
  [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md) page.
- Say what you did, what you expected and what happened instead, and your system: Windows, macOS
  or Linux, the Python and Node versions, and the model or CLI the agent ran on.
- Leave out keys, tokens and private file contents; KOLONİ's logs can hold paths and task text.
